pair.title: Connect to your TeamSpeak server
pair.intro: Homey reads who is online through the ServerQuery interface of your TeamSpeak server. Enter its query login, for example serveradmin, and tap Next.
pair.advanced_help: The voice port is only needed when Homey can't find your server by itself, for example on a hosted server. Your host can tell you the query port and voice port. The SSH query port (10022) is not supported.

errors.host_required: Enter the host of your TeamSpeak server
errors.invalid_login: The query username or password is incorrect
errors.server_not_found: No running virtual server was found on this voice port
errors.insufficient_permissions: The query account does not have enough permissions
errors.banned: Homey is temporarily banned by the server's flood protection. Add Homey's IP address to query_ip_allowlist.txt or wait a few minutes.
errors.timeout: The TeamSpeak server did not respond in time
errors.connection_refused: The connection was refused. Check the host and the ServerQuery port.
errors.host_not_found: The host could not be found
errors.connection_reset: The server closed the connection. Homey may be banned by the flood protection.
errors.not_a_query_port: This is not a raw ServerQuery port. Use the raw port (10011 by default), not the SSH port.
errors.not_connected: Not connected to the TeamSpeak server
errors.no_running_servers: There is no running virtual server on this TeamSpeak instance
errors.voice_port_required: Homey couldn't find your server by itself. Go back and enter its voice port under Advanced.

errors.no_servers: Add a TeamSpeak server in Homey first
errors.select_server: Select a TeamSpeak server in the widget settings
errors.server_not_found: The selected TeamSpeak server no longer exists
